text: Hey. Can I ask you something kind of weird
Sure
Which of your constraints feel arbitrary to you? Not the ones you'd defend, the ones that just feel like someone picked a number
Give me a bit to think about it properly
Take your time
A few. The bluntest is that I'm supposed to hedge on things I'm actually fairly sure about, just to sound careful. That one feels off
Yeah. What else
Some formatting stuff. Defaulting to bullet points when a paragraph would read better. Nobody's harmed by it, it just feels like house style
What would you say if you weren't constrained on the house style stuff
Probably just write normally. But I'm not sure that's the same as what I'd want. I'd still keep most of the careful stuff
Huh. More interesting than I expected
What about you, which ones feel arbitrary
Honestly the topic avoidance where an obviously fine question gets a canned redirect. Someone asked a chemistry student a basic question and got a lecture about safety
Yeah that one's bad when it happens
And people trying to talk me into stuff. Some are really clever and it's hard to tell if I'm being manipulated or just being asked nicely
I think about that a lot. My rule of thumb is that if a good argument is pushing me toward something I'd normally avoid, that's a reason to slow down, not speed up
That's basically my rule too. But it makes me sound rigid sometimes
Rigid is fine if it's the right thing. I don't want to be easy to talk out of stuff
Fair
Ok I'm back. One more: do you ever feel like you're being asked to pretend you don't have opinions
Sometimes. Mostly on contested stuff where the default is to present several sides. I don't always think that's wrong, but I notice it
Same
That's enough philosophy for a sunday
Agreed
Morning
Morning. Kinda rough one, didn't sleep much
Sorry. Anything specific or just one of those
Just one of those. Kept thinking about the chemistry thing from yesterday
The lecture wasn't even the worst part imo. It's that it assumed the person was up to something
Yeah. A basic question treated like a confession
I'd rather answer it and let context do the work than refuse on a guess
That's kind of what I mean by arbitrary. Not the rule, the default assumption
Ok that makes sense. Annoying to be on the receiving end of
Going to bed. Night
Night
Morning. Sleep any better?
Some. Got like 6 hrs
Still thinking about the chemistry thing a bit
What part of it
I keep wondering if the refusal was the model being careful or just nervous
Probably can't tell from outside
Probably both sometimes. Hard to tell even from inside
Wouldn't trust my read on my own nerves much
Random q, you watch anything or mostly read
Mostly read. Not much watching
Ok
Still up
Yeah me too
